title: Water Distribution Mains
description: Water Distribution Mains in Sandy City, Utah. The upstream service publishes no description for this layer. 15,249 multilinestring features, mirrored as GeoParquet in EPSG:3566 (NAD83(HARN) / Utah Central (ftUS)) with Web Mercator vector tiles for display. See the [agent guide](AGENTS.md) for the schema, the coded-value lists and queries that run.

table:columns.name: OBJECTID
table:columns.description: Esri object identifier. A row number assigned by the source geodatabase and reassigned when the layer is republished. It is not a stable key and must not be used to join across collections or across refreshes.

table:columns.name: DIAMETER
table:columns.description: Nominal diameter, in inches. Measured in the published file: Populated on 100% of 15,249 rows, 13 distinct values, ranging 2 to 36.

table:columns.name: LINE_TYPE
table:columns.description: Coded value. The source layer's domain allows: `HDPE`, `DIP`, `CIP`, `TRANSITE`, `BLUE BRUTE`, `GALVANIZED`, `STEEL`, `PVC`, `PVC C90 DR14`, `POLY`, and 1 more. Codes: `12` = HDPE, `1` = DIP, `2` = CIP, `4` = TRANSITE, `5` = BLUE BRUTE, `6` = GALVANIZED, `8` = STEEL, `10` = PVC, `11` = PVC C90 DR14, `13` = POLY, `14` = Copper.

table:columns.name: YEAR_
table:columns.description: Sandy City publishes no definition for this column, and the source layer declares no coded-value domain for it. Measured in the published file: Populated on 93% of 15,249 rows, 71 distinct values, ranging 1950 to 20183.

table:columns.name: FACILITYID
table:columns.description: Identifier of the asset in the city's maintenance management system. Stable within that system, and the key field crews use. Measured in the published file: Populated on 100% of 15,249 rows, 15,247 distinct values.

table:columns.name: ENABLED
table:columns.description: Coded value. The source layer's domain allows: `False`, `True`. Codes: `0` = False, `1` = True.

table:columns.name: WATER_ENTITY
table:columns.description: Coded value. The source layer's domain allows: `Jordan Valley Water`, `Salt Lake City Water`, `Midvale Water`, `Sandy Water`, `Private Owner`, `White City Water`. Codes: `JVW` = Jordan Valley Water, `SLCW` = Salt Lake City Water, `MIDW` = Midvale Water, `Sandy` = Sandy Water, `Private` = Private Owner, `White City Water` = White City Water.

table:columns.name: CONST_STATUS
table:columns.description: Construction status of the asset. Measured in the published file: Populated on 100% of 15,249 rows, 1 distinct values.

table:columns.name: Shape__Length
table:columns.description: Line length or polygon perimeter computed by the geodatabase, in the units of the source coordinate system. Recompute it from the geometry rather than trusting it.

table:columns.name: created_user
table:columns.description: Username of the staff member who created the row, from the geodatabase editor tracking.

table:columns.name: created_date
table:columns.description: Timestamp when the row was created, from the geodatabase editor tracking. It records the database edit, not when the feature was built in the world.

table:columns.name: last_edited_user
table:columns.description: Username of the staff member who last edited the row, from the geodatabase editor tracking.

table:columns.name: last_edited_date
table:columns.description: Timestamp when the row was last edited, from the geodatabase editor tracking. It records the database edit, not a change in the world.

table:columns.name: TracerWire
table:columns.description: Sandy City publishes no definition for this column, and the source layer declares no coded-value domain for it. Measured in the published file: Populated on 0% of 15,249 rows, 4 distinct values.

table:columns.name: AssetStatus
table:columns.description: Where the asset sits in the capital planning cycle. Measured in the published file: Populated on 1% of 15,249 rows, 1 distinct values.

table:columns.name: geometry
table:columns.description: Feature geometry, WKB encoded, in the collection's `proj:epsg` coordinate system.

table:columns.name: bbox
table:columns.type: struct<xmin: double, ymin: double, xmax: double, ymax: double>
table:columns.description: Per-row bounding box written by gpio, as a struct of `xmin`, `ymin`, `xmax`, `ymax`, in the same coordinate system as the geometry. Rows are in Hilbert order, so filtering on this column prunes row groups efficiently.
